LIGHTCANTRIP.title: Light Cantrip
LIGHTCANTRIP.noGM: Light Cantrip needs a GM logged in to change lights and items.
LIGHTCANTRIP.gmTimeout: Light Cantrip: the GM's browser did not answer. Try again.

allowHandoff.name: Allow hand-off
allowHandoff.hint: An ally within reach can hand an object to the caster, who lights it and hands it back (2024 PHB: the object can't be worn or carried by someone else when touched). Off: casters can only pick their own items.

handoffRange.name: Hand-off reach
handoffRange.hint: How close an ally must be to hand an object over, in grid units (default 5 ft = adjacent).

darkOnHandChange.name: Goes dark when it changes hands
darkOnHandChange.hint: A lit object moved to another character's inventory (drag, trade) stops shining. Firing, throwing and the module's own hand-off never trigger this. House rule; the PHB has no such limit.

openContainers.name: Open containers
openContainers.hint: Comma list of words. A lit object inside a container whose name contains one of these still shines (for example Quiver). Any other container (backpack, pouch, Bag of Holding) covers it.

daylightRule.name: Ends in daylight
daylightRule.hint: House rule: Light ends when its light is on a scene whose darkness is below the threshold. The PHB does not end Light in sunlight.

daylightThreshold.name: Daylight threshold
daylightThreshold.hint: Scene darkness below this counts as daylight. 0 is full day, 1 is full dark.

brightRadius.name: Bright radius
brightRadius.hint: Bright light radius in grid units. 2024 PHB: 20 ft.

dimRadius.name: Dim radius (total)
dimRadius.hint: Outer edge of dim light from the center, in grid units. 2024 PHB: 20 ft bright plus 20 ft dim = 40.

createMacro.name: Create the Light Cantrip macro
createMacro.hint: Adds a 'Light Cantrip' macro every player can drag to their hotbar.

defaultColor.name: Default light color
defaultColor.hint: Color the picker starts with. Remembered from your last cast.

picker.title: Light: {name}
picker.rule: Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't worn or carried by someone else. Bright light 20 ft, dim 20 ft more, 1 hour. Covering it blocks the light. Casting again ends it.
picker.handoffHint: Picking an ally's item: they hand it to you, you light it, and it goes back to them.

card.handoff: {owner} handed it to {caster}, who lit it and handed it back.
card.rule: Bright light 20 ft, dim 20 ft more. 1 hour (not timed here: dismiss it when the hour is up).
card.collectPrompt: {owner}: collect the lit {item}? Collecting ends the light.

reason.relit: another Light was cast on it

attack.noTarget: No target: the lit projectile's light dropped at your feet. Target a token before firing.

err.notObject: That is not an object that can be lit.
err.handoffOff: The GM has turned off hand-offs: pick one of your own items.
err.handoffTokens: Both tokens must be on the same scene for a hand-off.
err.handoffRange: The ally must be within {range} {units} to hand it over.
